# Data Path Checklist: Trust Gate Framework

**Purpose**: Assess whether the trust gate data-path requirements are complete, clear, and auditable for holistic ingest→transform→emit coverage.
**Created**: 2025-10-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are ingest-to-suite data contracts for every gate (golden-run, causality, ingest, timezone, universe, equity, accounting) explicitly enumerated so the harness knows each upstream artifact it depends on? [Completeness, Spec §FR-201; Plan §Phase 3A]
- [x] CHK002 Does the spec define deterministic sourcing and refresh workflow for leak-catcher, baseline, universe stamp, and ledger datasets so data freshness drift is governed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-202–§FR-208; Data Model §1]
- [x] CHK003 Are lineage/provenance fields (vendor version, correlation IDs, waiver refs) required at every persistence point (SQLite, manifest, JSON artifacts) so downstream audits have full coverage? [Completeness, Spec §FR-205–§FR-209; Data Model §2–§4]
- [x] CHK004 Are CI gating and waiver governance requirements tied to specific documentation updates (`WAIVERS.md`, `docs/operations/trust_gates.md`) to ensure emission-stage responsibilities are complete? [Completeness, Spec §FR-210–§FR-212; Tasks §Phase 4]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Are tolerances for corporate-action reconciliation, accounting drift, and timezone normalization quantitatively stated (bps, seconds, decimal precision) rather than implied? [Clarity, Spec §FR-204, §FR-207–§FR-208; Configs §T001]
- [x] CHK006 Is the definition of “holistic data path” spelled out so readers know whether upstream ingest retries, transformation caching, and manifest signing are in scope? [Clarity, Spec §FR-201; Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK007 Are criteria for declaring a gate “waived” versus “failed with remediation” unambiguously documented for solo operators? [Clarity, Spec §FR-210; Quickstart §Failure Triage]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK008 Do CLI, API, manifest, and SSE contracts describe the same trust gate fields and status vocabulary without conflicts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-209; Data Model §4]
- [x] CHK009 Are tolerance profiles referenced consistently across config files, plan assumptions, and tasks so no profile name drift occurs? [Consistency, Spec §FR-204; Tasks §Phase 3A; Quickstart §Prerequisites]
- [x] CHK010 Is the promise of selective execution (`--only`) aligned between CLI contract, CI policy, and waiver text to avoid contradictory enforcement rules? [Consistency, Spec §FR-213; Quickstart §Running the Trust Gate Suite; Tasks §Phase 3A]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK011 Can each gate’s “pass” condition be objectively evaluated using the metrics called out in the spec (hash match, Sharpe epsilon, symbol counts, duration bounds)? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-202–§FR-208]
- [x] CHK012 Are success/failure diagnostics required to cite measurable evidence (hash diffs, metric deltas, timestamp lists) rather than qualitative statements? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-202–§FR-208; Quickstart §Failure Triage]
- [x] CHK013 Do CI gating rules specify measurable readiness states (e.g., all gates pass OR documented waiver with expiry) before promotion proceeds? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-210; Tasks §Phase 4]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK014 Are alternate flows (refreshing baselines, running subset locally, regenerating universe stamps) fully captured so the solo operator can follow deterministic steps? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases; Quickstart §Baseline Management]
- [x] CHK015 Are exception flows for rate limits, insufficient data bars, or missing corporate actions included with documented remediation paths? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases; Research §Vendor Reliability]
- [x] CHK016 Are recovery flows after a failed gate (rerun ingest, request new waiver, regenerate baseline) laid out with clear triggers and outputs? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases; Quickstart §Failure Triage]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK017 Do requirements enumerate what happens when baseline versions skew, datasets shrink, or timezone anomalies occur, including how evidence is recorded? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases; Data Model §3]
- [x] CHK018 Is there explicit guidance on handling tolerance-profile conflicts when multiple gates share metrics (e.g., equity vs accounting tolerances)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK019 Are runtime SLAs (≤120 s per gate, ≤1.5× Masters baseline) documented alongside observability metrics so performance monitoring is traceable? [Non-Functional, Plan §Technical Context; Spec §FR-211; Tasks §Phase 4]
- [x] CHK020 Are security and retention considerations for vendor metadata, signed artifacts, and waiver records described with measurable retention timelines? [Non-Functional, Spec §NFR-201–§NFR-203; Data Model §3]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK021 Are assumptions about dataset availability, signing keys, and vendor credentials explicitly called out so blockers are visible before execution? [Assumption, Quickstart §Prerequisites; Plan §Phase 0]
- [x] CHK022 Are external dependencies (Prometheus, structlog, SQLite JSON1, waiver governance) listed with version/availability requirements? [Dependency, Plan §Technical Context; Tasks §Dependencies]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK023 Is “data freshness drift” defined with measurable thresholds so ingest reruns can determine pass/fail without interpretation? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-206]
- [x] CHK024 Are lineage/provenance reporting obligations reconciled between solo operator expectations and governance policy to avoid conflicting responsibilities? [Conflict, Spec §FR-205–§FR-210; Spec §NFR-204; Plan §Summary]
